catalogNotesBefore: Meet the colonists, trade at Basic General, and establish a Lattice link. WASD or arrows move; Shift runs; the mouse turns the camera (hold Left Alt for a pointer). The mouse wheel zooms into first person. E interacts. Tab opens the field pack and J the journal. Esc closes a panel or pauses. R returns to East Gate.
